title: The Parole Bond Bounty
logline: A predatory bail bondsman inflates an ex-convict's discharge ledger with fictitious administrative penalties, prompting an armed skip toward unpatrolled outer-rim moorings.

roles.description: Underwrites release bonds for parolees; calculates compound interest on every breath and tracks defaulters relentlessly.
A patched light freighter operated by a newly released convict desperate to leave the system.
A customized patrol interceptor hired by the bondsman to disable skips before they cross the jump gate.
The administrative station mooring where parole indentures and release filings are logged.
An unregulated outer-rim mooring where independent haulers take cash jobs without transponder checks.

public_situation: Station authorities in {system} have posted a recovery warrant for a parolee freighter that departed without clearing indenture fees.
private_truth: {role:parole_bondsman} inflated the parolee's release interest rates with bogus administrative penalties to force the pilot into permanent indentured freight runs.

beats.public_change: The administrative registry issues an amber skip alert for {role:parolee_freighter} across system channels.

missions.reason: The bondsman hires an outside pilot to analyze the records dock comms beacon to isolate the freighter's departure vector.
missions.private_fact: He knows an audit is scheduled tomorrow that would reveal he added fictitious recovery fees to the parole contract.

beats.public_change: Customs officers at {role:free_freight_cove} receive notice of an impending asset seizure.

missions.reason: He pays the pilot to deliver an expedited interdiction writ to dockmasters before the hauler can refuel and jump.
missions.private_fact: He forged the magistrate stamp on the writ because official authorization takes three business days.

beats.public_change: {role:bounty_enforcer} corners {role:parolee_freighter} in open space near the outer jump buoy.

missions.reason: The bondsman contracts the pilot to disable the fleeing freighter's sublight engines so his enforcer can attach tow cables.
missions.private_fact: The parolee offers decrypted ledger chips proving the bondsman doubled her debt if the pilot turns and disables {role:bounty_enforcer}.

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot disables the freighter, allowing the bondsman to impound the ship and enforce the indenture.
resolutions.summary: {role:parole_bondsman} impounds {role:parolee_freighter}, forcing its pilot into an extended indentured hauling contract to cover inflated recovery fees.

consequences.public_summary: A bounty runner helped an orbital bondsman drag a desperate parolee back into debt bondage.

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot takes the parolee's offer, disables the enforcer, and covers the freighter's jump.
resolutions.summary: {role:parolee_freighter} jumps to unpatrolled rim territory. {role:parole_bondsman} loses his bond stake and faces mounting creditor scrutiny.

consequences.public_summary: A hired gun turned on a loan shark's enforcer to let a debt-trapped parolee make the jump.

resolutions.reached_by: The trail goes cold, or the pilot avoids taking contracts.
resolutions.summary: {role:parolee_freighter} slips into dark space without clearing paperwork. {role:parole_bondsman} writes off the defaulted indenture as an operating loss.

loose_threads.detail: The parole indenture slates bear interest multipliers coded to an anonymous escrow desk on an outer moon.
The magistrate seizure authorization is stamped with an electronic signet belonging to an inspector retired three years ago.
A salvage brokerage listed {role:parolee_freighter} on an advance repo auction two days before the hauler was declared delinquent.

radio_hooks: Administrative registry issues recovery alert for uncertified freighter departure in {system}.
Independent haulers protest rising surety bond rates demanded by dockside parole agencies.
Bounty chasers congregate near outer gate beacons following reports of a high-value skip.

voice_direction.parole_bondsman: Fast-talking, condescending, constantly citing subsection numbers. Speaks as though everything in the cosmos is already mortgaged to him.

title: The Parole Board Lottery
logline: A crooked station bookmaker rigs the annual physical raffle drum for inmate early release using hidden magnetic coils, triggering a betting war with the station's suspicious ombudsperson.

roles.description: Station bookmaker running side bets on the annual parole lottery; nervous, fast-talking, drowning in debt.
Station civic monitor tasked with certifying the annual raffle; pedantic, obsessed with procedural purity.
A polished brass mechanical lottery sphere fitted with secret electromagnets in the intake hopper.
The station terminal where selected parolees are formally processed and issued civilian flight passes.
A bustling station concourse where passengers and off-duty crew place heavy bets on lottery numbers.

public_situation: The annual parole lottery is underway in {system}, drawing large crowds to station betting lounges as names are selected.
private_truth: {role:lottery_steward} loaded {role:rigged_lottery_drum} with magnetized tokens to guarantee that his syndicate's betting pool claims the grand payout.

beats.public_change: The civic ombudsperson announces an emergency calibration hold on {role:rigged_lottery_drum}.

missions.reason: The ombudsperson hires an independent pilot to run a calibrated electromagnetic scanner over the raffle drum before the ceremony.
missions.private_fact: She suspects the drum was tampered with, but she has placed her own quiet bet on number thirty-seven.

beats.public_change: Odds shift wildly in {role:lounge_wagering_hall} as rumor spreads that certain numbers are guaranteed to drop.

missions.reason: The steward pays the pilot to courier advance winning payout vouchers to his betting syndicate partners.
missions.private_fact: He borrowed against syndicate loan sharks to finance the bribe that secured access to the drum.

missions.reason: She contracts the pilot to pick up the locked archive safe containing the uncorrupted spare token set.
missions.private_fact: She wants the backup tokens ready in case she decides to swap out the steward's rigged batch.

beats.public_change: A ceremonial fanfare sounds as crowds assemble in front of {role:penal_intake_depot} for the live drawing.

missions.reason: The ombudsperson hires the pilot to deliver the official ballot seals to the podium before the drawing commences.
missions.private_fact: She placed an undeclared side wager on number thirty-seven to recoup her department's audit budget shortfall.

player_choice.prompt: The raffle drum is ready to spin. The pilot can load the honest tokens, let the syndicate's rigged draw proceed, or expose the magnets live on station broadcast.

options.label: Secretly swap in the honest tokens so genuinely random convicts are paroled
Let the rigged draw proceed and split the steward's massive betting pool payout
Broadcast sensor evidence of the magnetic coils directly to the betting lounge screens

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot secretly swaps in the unmagnetized backup tokens.
resolutions.summary: Randomly selected convicts receive unexpected paroles. {role:lottery_steward}'s syndicate loses its wager, and bookmakers demand his skin.

consequences.public_summary: A hired courier secretly swapped out loaded tokens, turning a crooked parole raffle honest.

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot lets the rigged drawing proceed and cashes in on the syndicate's payout.
resolutions.summary: The magnetized draw drops the expected numbers. {role:lottery_steward} cashes out a fortune, while pre-selected convicts walk out into freedom.

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot broadcasts the magnetic sensor logs across lounge monitors.
resolutions.summary: Bettors and convicts riot upon learning {role:rigged_lottery_drum} was fixed. Station guards impose martial law, and all paroles are cancelled.

consequences.public_summary: A station riot broke out when a pilot showed that the annual parole raffle was rigged with magnets.

resolutions.reached_by: The ombudsperson fails to challenge the drum, or the pilot takes no action.
resolutions.summary: {role:rigged_lottery_drum} operates without scrutiny. {role:lottery_steward} quietly settles syndicate debts, and the warden covers up discrepancies.

loose_threads.detail: A customs crate of magnetic coil solenoids was delivered under the personal manifest of an off-system bail bond executive.
Betting margins across three station lounges shifted toward four specific convict serial numbers twenty hours before the draw.
The official certification seal on the raffle hopper was authorized using an electronic key issued to a clerk on extended leave.

radio_hooks: Anticipation mounts in {system} as stations prepare for the annual ceremonial parole lottery.
Lounge bookmakers report record betting turnover on this season's parole candidate pool.
Station ombuds office reaffirms commitment to transparent and impartial correctional lotteries.

voice_direction.lottery_steward: Fast, breathless patter loaded with betting jargon and shifting excuses. Never names who he owes money to.
voice_direction.ombudsperson: Monotone, pedantic, obsessed with procedural minutiae and protocol manuals. Pronounces statutory codes with solemn reverence.
